question: How does Redis Sentinel achieve automated master failover?
category: How does Redis Sentinel achieve automated master failover?

options.text: Sentinels monitor master nodes via heartbeat pings; when a quorum agrees master is down (ODOWN), a sentinel is elected to promote a replica.
16,384 hash slots. Keys are mapped using CRC16(key) mod 16384....
Wrapping part of a key in braces {user:101} forces Redis Cluster to hash only the braced substring, placing related keys in the same slot.
The node responds with a -MOVED <slot> <ip:port> redirection error instructing the client where to route the request.

explanation: Sentinels monitor master nodes via heartbeat pings; when a quorum agrees master is down (ODOWN), a sentinel is elected to promote a replica.
